# ovirt_vms (Data Source)

The ovirt_vms data source returns a list of virtual machines matching the given search criteria.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) Filter virtual machines by cluster ID.
- `fail_on_empty` (Boolean) Fail if no virtual machines matching the criteria were found.
- `name` (String) Filter virtual machines by exact name.
- `status` (String) Filter virtual machines by status (e.g. up, down).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vms` (Set of Object) Set of virtual machines matching the search criteria. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:
